name: Free Range Printer Raspberry Pi Box

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a low-profile, rectangular protective top cover designed to sit over a base stand. It features a wide, flat top surface with clean, vertical side walls. One of the vertical walls includes a small circular hole near the corner for an LED indicator, and the back wall has a wide rectangular cutout to allow cables to pass through cleanly.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric top cover for a receipt printer stand that encloses a Raspberry Pi. The script should allow customization of the printer dimensions (width and length), the cable gap size at the back, and the inclusion/diameter of an LED hole.
captions.factory: The 'cover' module is constructed using a difference operation on a large outer cube and an inner hollow cube to create the thin-walled shell. A rear rectangular cutout is subtracted using a translated cube, and an optional LED indicator hole is subtracted using a rotated cylinder. Additionally, the bottom edges of the shell are chamfered by subtracting thin cubes rotated at 45 degrees, and internal standon cylinders are positioned to secure the Raspberry Pi.
